meta.label: synthetic, literature-informed

schema_notes.eats_groups: Filter on taxa: group, feeding_groups, habitats (any overlap), max_size_mm. emerging_only=true restricts to taxa with emerges=true (aerial/riparian consumers eat the emerged adult stage).
schema_notes.eats_emerging_adults: Consumer also takes emerged adults of emerges=true prey.
schema_notes.share: Approximate fraction of consumer diet covered by the rule.
schema_notes.prey_stage: Optional; life stage eaten when not the default.
schema_notes.bmwp_score: Original BMWP family score (Pisces table); families split since the table take the score of their former parent family (see taxon notes).
schema_notes.pollution_sensitive: BMWP 8 or 10, plus Rhyacophilidae, Glossosomatidae and the pearl mussel.
schema_notes.exclusions: Taxa considered and left out, with reason.
